Container.Name: NetProbe-test
Container.Overview:
NetProbe 2.1 - Internet Quality Monitoring Dashboard
Monitor network connectivity, packet loss, latency, jitter, DNS response times, connection quality, and bandwidth.
- HTTPS dashboard with administrator and guest read-only access. - First-run administrator creation and monitoring wizard. - Scheduled Ping, DNS, and Speedtest tests, historical graphs, and manual diagnostics. - SQLite by default; optional external PostgreSQL through Settings. - Saved WebUI settings take precedence over initial Docker environment seeds.
Data, administrator credentials, certificates, and SQLite history persist at /config.
Official Ookla CLI is optional proprietary software, not bundled in this image. Review and acknowledge Ookla terms and install through the administrator WebUI before using its backend.
Documentation: https://github.com/bmartino1/NetProbe_Python
Container.Requires:
Bridge mode: host 8443 maps to container HTTPS 8443; optional host 8080 maps to container HTTP 80. Unraid host ports 80 and 443 remain untouched.
Persist /config. On a first install, open the HTTPS WebUI to create an administrator account and complete monitoring setup. A self-signed TLS certificate is generated by default.
The official Ookla CLI is NOT bundled. Users must review and acknowledge Ookla's terms and install it separately through administrator Settings. Selecting the Ookla backend alone does not install the executable.
PostgreSQL is optional and requires an independently deployed, reachable server. Database selection and credentials can be saved under Settings; switching does not migrate existing SQLite history.

Config.Name: DockerNatPort
Config.Description: NetProbe HTTPS WebUI. Maps Unraid host port 8443 to container port 8443; does not use Unraid host port 443.

Config.Name: NetProbe Configuration and Database
Config.Description: Persistent monitoring settings, SQLite data, administrator credentials, HTTPS certificates and optional Ookla acknowledgement. Back up before changing mappings.

Config.Name: APP_TIMEZONE
Config.Description: Initial application timezone, such as America/Chicago. Saved WebUI configuration takes precedence afterward.

Config.Name: Speedtest Backend
Config.Description: First-boot backend preference: ookla or python. Ookla must be installed through administrator Settings after acknowledging its terms.

Config.Name: Ookla Terms Acknowledgement
Config.Description: Optional: enter I_ACCEPT only AFTER personally reviewing and agreeing to Ookla's EULA, Terms and Privacy Policy. Leaving this blank requires acknowledgement in the WebUI. Does not install Ookla.

Config.Name: SPEEDTEST_ENABLED
Config.Description: Initial setting for scheduled bandwidth testing. The Ookla binary must be installed before Ookla tests can run.

Config.Name: HTTP Redirect
Config.Description: Optional HTTP redirect. Unraid host port 8080 maps to container port 80, without binding Unraid host port 80.

Config.Name: Minimum Administrator Password Length
Config.Description: Initial administrator password minimum. Default 8; minimum 6. Later editable through the WebUI.

Config.Name: DB_ENGINE
Config.Description: Initial database engine: sqlite or postgres. An existing saved database profile may take precedence.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_HOST
Config.Description: Optional external PostgreSQL host or reachable IP. Do not set for SQLite-only installations.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
Config.Description: External PostgreSQL password. Do not use a shared or public default.
